_comment: Art that proves the STASH panel is open, plus the region it covers. Same mechanism and
same reasoning as inventory.json - read that one first; this is the second panel, and
adding it was a data change rather than a code change, which is the point.
THE TEMPLATE IS THE PANEL'S TITLE BAR - the word STASH and the stone around it. It has to
be the title and not the tabs: the tab row underneath (Personal / Shared / Gems /
Materials / Runes) HIGHLIGHTS whichever tab is selected, so a template covering it would
match well on one tab and badly on the others. Measured with the template cut from the
Materials tab: 1.000 on the Materials panel and 0.982 on the Runes panel, against 0.179
on in-game frames with it closed, and 0.10-0.17 on frames where only the INVENTORY is
open - the two panels do not match each other.
The stash is on the LEFT and the inventory on the RIGHT, and in town both are usually open
at once, so both regions are excluded together and the world is the strip between them.
Panel edges measured on the real frame: left 105, right 688, top 105, bottom ~840 of
1912x1076. keep_out runs to the window's left edge, because the outer chrome there is also
keep_out and search_region are fractions of the ANCHOR WINDOW; source_size is the
resolution the art was cut AT, not the template's own size.
name: stash title
